Building directly on the doctrinal philosophy framework of Volume~I ({{ref:vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy}}) and Shulman's 2-Chu-Dialectica pairing~\cite{Shulman20}, Volume~II systematizes the calibration of structural probe suites {{sym:probe-suite}} across universes, classes, and higher fixed points. Under Definition~\ref{ch01:def:adm-pareto-frontier}, admissible extents $\mathrm{Adm}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}$ form a refinement poset whose inclusion-maximal minimal Pareto frontier {{sym:pareto-res}} partitions cleanly into Provable Scotoma ($\emptyset$), Unique Conceptual Residuum ($|\mathrm{Res}^{\min}| = 1$), or Multi-Dimensional Pareto Schism ($|\mathrm{Res}^{\min}| \ge 2$) by Theorem~\ref{ch01:thm:scotoma-pareto-trichotomy}. Along a monotone probe filtration $\mathcal{P}_t$, Theorem~\ref{ch01:thm:flow-f1-threshold-order} proves unconditionally that the awakening threshold precedes the dogma threshold (${{sym:twake}} \le {{sym:tdogma}}$). Crucially, however, Counterexample~\ref{ch01:cex:flow-f1-frontier-nonmonotone} demonstrates why $|{{sym:pareto-res}}|$ need not vary monotonically inside $[{{sym:twake}}, {{sym:tdogma}})$: new probes introduced at intermediate stages can first split a single admissible residuum into an incomparable Pareto Schism ($1 \mapsto 2$) before a subsequent coarser unifying probe subsumes both branches back into a single strictly weaker residuum ($2 \mapsto 1$) without ever collapsing $T$ into Dogma. Finally, {{ref:ch01:rem:trident-mode3-2ltt-bootstrap}} previews the zero-\texttt{Mathlib} two-level type theory kernel boundary separating fibrant and strict types.

\begin{definition}[Vertical Unification of the Obstruction Trident]\label{ch01:def:essential-fiber-trident}%
\uses{vol1:def:comparison-triple,vol1:def:residuum}%
Over a comparison functor $\Phi : \mathcal{A} \to \mathcal{B}$ and a groupoid structure $G$ on $\mathcal{B}$ extending {{ref:vol1:def:comparison-triple}} and {{ref:vol1:def:residuum}}, the \textbf{essential fiber}\index{Essential fiber} at $b \in \mathcal{B}$ is
\[
  \mathcal{F}_b(\Phi) \;:=\; {{sym:hofib}}_b(\Phi) \;:=\; \sum_{a : A} \mathrm{Equiv}_{\mathcal{B}}(\Phi(a), b).
\]
Evaluating $\mathcal{F}_b(\Phi)$ stratifies all three vertical obstruction modes into one invariant:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textbf{Mode~(\roman*).},leftmargin=4.2em]
  \item \textbf{Section Inhabitation (Immanent vs.\ Transcendent Polarity):} $(-1)$-truncation $\|\mathcal{F}_b(\Phi)\|_{-1}$ (\texttt{Nonempty}) tests splitting without forcing $(-2)$-contractibility (\texttt{Subsingleton}), polarized between \emph{Immanent} internal slice splitting and \emph{Transcendent} global-section splitting.
  \item \textbf{Monic-Completion Phantom Defect:} When $\Phi$ is monic (injective on objects with trivial automorphisms), $\mathcal{F}_b(\Phi)$ is automatically a \texttt{Subsingleton}, concentrating the phantom obstruction solely in emptiness (\texttt{IsEmpty}).
  \item \textbf{Framed Lifts (Haecceity) vs.\ Species (Quiddity) and Isotropy:} Post-composition by $\mathrm{Aut}_{\mathcal{B}}(b)$ acts on rigidified pairs $(a, \theta) \in \mathcal{F}_b(\Phi)$ (\textbf{Framed Lifts} / \emph{Haecceity}), partitioning them into $\mathrm{Aut}_{\mathcal{B}}(b)$-orbits (\textbf{Species} / \emph{Quiddity}) governed by residual stabilizer \textbf{Isotropy} $\mathrm{Stab}_{\mathrm{Aut}_{\mathcal{B}}(b)}(a, \theta)$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{definition}

/-- Constructive groupoid equivalence structure on a base carrier `B` (zero axioms). -/
structure GroupoidStructure (B : Type) where
  /-- Equivalences `b₁ ≃ b₂` in the base groupoid. -/
  Hom : B → B → Type
  /-- Identity equivalence. -/
  id : ∀ b : B, Hom b b
  /-- Composition of equivalences. -/
  comp : ∀ {b₁ b₂ b₃ : B}, Hom b₁ b₂ → Hom b₂ b₃ → Hom b₁ b₃
  /-- Inverse equivalence. -/
  inv : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : B}, Hom b₁ b₂ → Hom b₂ b₁
  /-- Left identity law. -/
  id_comp : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : B} (f : Hom b₁ b₂), comp (id b₁) f = f
  /-- Right identity law. -/
  comp_id : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : B} (f : Hom b₁ b₂), comp f (id b₂) = f
  /-- Associativity of composition. -/
  assoc : ∀ {b₁ b₂ b₃ b₄ : B} (f : Hom b₁ b₂) (g : Hom b₂ b₃) (h : Hom b₃ b₄),
    comp (comp f g) h = comp f (comp g h)
  /-- Left inverse law. -/
  inv_comp : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : B} (f : Hom b₁ b₂), comp (inv f) f = id b₂
  /-- Right inverse law. -/
  comp_inv : ∀ {b₁ b₂ : B} (f : Hom b₁ b₂), comp f (inv f) = id b₁

/-- Essential fiber `ℱ_b(Φ) := ∑_{a : A} Equiv_B(Φ a, b)` unifying Obstruction Modes (i)–(iii). -/
structure EssentialFiber {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) (Φ : A → B) (b : B) : Type where
  /-- Lifted object `a : A`. -/
  obj : A
  /-- Framing equivalence `θ : Φ(a) ≃_B b`. -/
  framing : G.Hom (Φ obj) b

/-- Mode (i) section inhabitation: `(-1)`-truncation `Nonempty (EssentialFiber G Φ b)`. -/
def Mode1SectionInhabited {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) (Φ : A → B) (b : B) : Prop :=
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- Strict Mode (i) non-contractible splitting: inhabited without `Subsingleton`. -/
def Mode1NonContractibleSplit {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) (Φ : A → B) (b : B) : Prop :=
  Mode1SectionInhabited G Φ b ∧ ¬ Subsingleton (EssentialFiber G Φ b)

/-- Polarity separating Immanent (internal slice) from Transcendent (external global-section) splitting. -/
inductive SplittingPolarity : Type
  | immanent
  | transcendent
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Mode (ii) monic-completion phantom defect: automatic `Subsingleton` with empty essential fiber. -/
def Mode2PhantomDefect {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) (Φ : A → B) (b : B) : Prop :=
  Subsingleton (EssentialFiber G Φ b) ∧ IsEmpty (EssentialFiber G Φ b)

/-- Automorphism carrier `Aut_B(b) := Hom_B(b, b)`. -/
def BaseAut {B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) (b : B) : Type :=
  G.Hom b b

/-- Post-composition action of `Aut_B(b)` on Framed Lifts (`Haecceity`). -/
def frameAct {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) {Φ : A → B} {b : B}
    (g : BaseAut G b) (x : EssentialFiber G Φ b) : EssentialFiber G Φ b :=
  ⟨x.obj, G.comp x.framing g⟩

/-- Species (`Quiddity`) orbit relation on Framed Lifts under `Aut_B(b)`. -/
def SameSpecies {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) {Φ : A → B} {b : B}
    (x y : EssentialFiber G Φ b) : Prop :=
  ∃ g : BaseAut G b, frameAct G g x = y

/-- Higher Isotropy stabilizer of a Framed Lift inside `Aut_B(b)`. -/
def LiftIsotropy {A B : Type} (G : GroupoidStructure B) {Φ : A → B} {b : B}
    (x : EssentialFiber G Φ b) : Type :=
  { g : BaseAut G b // frameAct G g x = x }

/-- Discrete equality groupoid on a base type `B`. -/
def discreteGroupoid (B : Type) : GroupoidStructure B where
  Hom b₁ b₂ := PLift (b₁ = b₂)
  id _ := ⟨rfl⟩
  comp f g := ⟨f.down.trans g.down⟩
  inv f := ⟨f.down.symm⟩
  id_comp _ := rfl
  comp_id _ := rfl
  assoc _ _ _ := rfl
  inv_comp _ := rfl
  comp_inv _ := rfl

/-- Injective completion maps yield automatic `Subsingleton` fibers, isolating Mode (ii) phantoms in `IsEmpty`. -/
theorem mode2_phantom_of_injective_not_mem {A B : Type} {Φ : A → B}
    (hInj : Function.Injective Φ) (b : B) (hNotMem : ∀ a : A, Φ a ≠ b) :
    Mode2PhantomDefect (discreteGroupoid B) Φ b := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩, ⟨fun x ↦ hNotMem x.obj x.framing.down⟩⟩
  cases x with | mk a₁ f₁ =>
  cases y with | mk a₂ f₂ =>
  cases f₁ with | up h₁ =>
  cases f₂ with | up h₂ =>
  have ha : a₁ = a₂ := hInj (h₁.trans h₂.symm)
  cases ha
  rfl

\begin{theorem}[Mode~(iii) Orbit--Stabilizer Exactness and $(R_{2,2}, \phi_{\mathrm{aug}})$ Decomposition]\label{ch01:thm:mode3-orbit-stabilizer-exactness}%
\uses{ch01:def:essential-fiber-trident}%
Constructively without invoking \texttt{Classical.choice} (stratum \textbf{Amber}: using only \texttt{propext} and \texttt{Quot.sound}):
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\arabic*)},leftmargin=2.0em]
  \item For any group $G$ acting on a lift fiber $F$ and any basepoint $x_0 \in F$, the quotient-stabilizer map $\mathrm{orbitMap}_{x_0} : G / \mathrm{Stab}_G(x_0) \to F$ is injective with image $\mathrm{Orbit}_G(x_0)$, while the Species projection $F \to F / G$ identifies two Framed Lifts if and only if $\exists g \in G,\; g \cdot x = y$.
  \item On the $(R_{2,2}, \phi_{\mathrm{aug}})$ linear-endomorphism Touchstone $M_2(\mathbb{F}_2)$ under conjugation by $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_2) \cong \mathrm{Aut}(R_{2,2})$ ($|\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_2)| = 6$), the $16$ Framed Lifts (Haecceities) partition constructively into $6$ conjugacy Species (Quiddities) of cardinalities
  \[
    1 + 1 + 3 + 3 + 6 + 2 = 16.
  \]
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
For~(1), avoiding Mathlib's \texttt{Quotient.out} and \texttt{MulAction.orbitRel} (which invoke classical choice internally), we form the left-coset setoid $g_1^{-1} g_2 \in \mathrm{Stab}_G(x_0)$ and orbit setoid $\exists g \in G,\; g \cdot x = y$ constructively; \texttt{Quotient.lift}, \texttt{Quotient.inductionOn}, and \texttt{Quotient.sound} verify injectivity onto $\mathrm{Orbit}_G(x_0)$ and the exact Species criterion using only \texttt{propext} and \texttt{Quot.sound}. For~(2), enumerating $M_2(\mathbb{F}_2)$ ($16$ matrices) and $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_2)$ ($6$ invertible matrices) via explicit \texttt{Fintype} lists and classifying by zero/identity/determinant/trace invariants yields a constructive equivalence $M_2(\mathbb{F}_2)/\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_2) \simeq \mathbf{Fin}\,6$ with orbit sizes $[1, 1, 3, 3, 6, 2]$ ($0$, $I$, $3$ rank-$1$ nilpotents, $3$ involutions in $\mathrm{GL}_2(\mathbb{F}_2)$, $6$ rank-$1$ projections, and $2$ order-$3$ rotations).
\end{proof}

        change (g₁⁻¹ * g₂) • x0 = x0 at h
        change (g₂⁻¹ * g₁) • x0 = x0
        have h1 : (g₁⁻¹ * g₂)⁻¹ • x0 = x0 := by rw [inv_smul_eq_iff, h]
        rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] at h1
        exact h1
      trans := fun {g₁ g₂ g₃} h12 h23 ↦ by
        change (g₁⁻¹ * g₂) • x0 = x0 at h12
        change (g₂⁻¹ * g₃) • x0 = x0 at h23
        change (g₁⁻¹ * g₃) • x0 = x0
        have hmul : g₁⁻¹ * g₃ = (g₁⁻¹ * g₂) * (g₂⁻¹ * g₃) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc g₂, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
        rw [hmul, mul_smul, h23, h12] }

/-- Constructive `G`-orbit setoid on `F` (`x ~ y ↔ ∃ g, g • x = y`, zero `Classical.choice`). -/
def speciesOrbitSetoid (G F : Type) [Group G] [MulAction G F] : Setoid F where
  r x y := ∃ g : G, g • x = y
  iseqv :=
    { refl := fun x ↦ ⟨1, one_smul G x⟩
      symm := fun ⟨g, hg⟩ ↦ ⟨g⁻¹, by rw [← hg, inv_smul_smul]⟩
      trans := fun ⟨g₁, h1⟩ ⟨g₂, h2⟩ ↦ ⟨g₂ * g₁, by rw [mul_smul, h1, h2]⟩ }

/-- Quotient-stabilizer orbit injection `G / Stab_G(x₀) → F` defined via `Quotient.lift`. -/
def orbitMap {G F : Type} [Group G] [MulAction G F] (x0 : F) :
    Quotient (stabilizerLeftSetoid (G := G) x0) → F :=
  Quotient.lift (fun g : G ↦ g • x0) (by
    intro g₁ g₂ h
    change (g₁⁻¹ * g₂) • x0 = x0 at h
    calc
      g₁ • x0 = g₁ • ((g₁⁻¹ * g₂) • x0) := by rw [h]
      _ = (g₁ * (g₁⁻¹ * g₂)) • x0 := by rw [← mul_smul]
      _ = g₂ • x0 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel_left])

/-- Canonical Species (`Quiddity`) quotient projection `F → F / G`. -/
def speciesQuot {G F : Type} [Group G] [MulAction G F] :
    F → Quotient (speciesOrbitSetoid G F) :=
  Quotient.mk (speciesOrbitSetoid G F)

/-- Orbit-stabilizer injectivity and exact range `MulAction.orbit G x0` (Amber: zero `Classical.choice`). -/
theorem orbitMap_injective_and_range {G F : Type} [Group G] [MulAction G F] (x0 : F) :
    Function.Injective (orbitMap (G := G) x0) ∧
    Set.range (orbitMap (G := G) x0) = MulAction.orbit G x0 := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- Exact Species equality criterion `speciesQuot x = speciesQuot y ↔ ∃ g, g • x = y`. -/
theorem speciesQuot_eq_iff {G F : Type} [Group G] [MulAction G F] (x y : F) :
    speciesQuot (G := G) x = speciesQuot (G := G) y ↔ ∃ g : G, g • x = y :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ Quotient.exact h, fun h ↦ Quotient.sound h⟩

/-- Concrete `2 × 2` matrices over `𝔽₂` modeling the `16` Framed Lifts of `(R_{2,2}, φ_aug)`. -/
structure M2F2 : Type where
  /-- `(0,0)` entry. -/
  a : Bool
  /-- `(0,1)` entry. -/
  b : Bool
  /-- `(1,0)` entry. -/
  c : Bool
  /-- `(1,1)` entry. -/
  d : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace M2F2

/-- `2 × 2` identity matrix over `𝔽₂`. -/
def one : M2F2 := ⟨true, false, false, true⟩

/-- Matrix multiplication over `𝔽₂`. -/
def mul (x y : M2F2) : M2F2 :=
  ⟨xor (x.a && y.a) (x.b && y.c),
   xor (x.a && y.b) (x.b && y.d),
   xor (x.c && y.a) (x.d && y.c),
   xor (x.c && y.b) (x.d && y.d)⟩

/-- Determinant over `𝔽₂`. -/
def det (x : M2F2) : Bool := xor (x.a && x.d) (x.b && x.c)

/-- Adjugate (= inverse when `det = true`) over `𝔽₂`. -/
def adj (x : M2F2) : M2F2 := ⟨x.d, x.b, x.c, x.a⟩

/-- Exhaustive list of all `16` elements of `M₂(𝔽₂)`. -/
def allList : List M2F2 :=
  [false, true].flatMap fun a ↦
  [false, true].flatMap fun b ↦
  [false, true].flatMap fun c ↦
  [false, true].map fun d ↦ ⟨a, b, c, d⟩

instance : Fintype M2F2 where
  elems := ⟨Multiset.ofList allList, by decide⟩
  complete m := by rcases m with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> decide

end M2F2

/-- Concrete general linear group `GL₂(𝔽₂) ≅ Aut(R_{2,2})` of invertible `2 × 2` matrices over `𝔽₂`. -/
abbrev GL2F2 : Type := { m : M2F2 // m.det = true }

private lemma bool_mat_assoc_entry (p q r s t u v w : Bool) :
    xor (xor (p && q) (r && s) && t) (xor (p && u) (r && v) && w) =
    xor (p && xor (q && t) (u && w)) (r && xor (s && t) (v && w)) := by
  cases p <;> cases q <;> cases r <;> cases s <;>
  cases t <;> cases u <;> cases v <;> cases w <;> rfl

private lemma m2f2_mul_assoc (x y z : M2F2) : (x.mul y).mul z = x.mul (y.mul z) := by
  cases x; cases y; cases z
  dsimp only [M2F2.mul]
  rw [bool_mat_assoc_entry, bool_mat_assoc_entry, bool_mat_assoc_entry, bool_mat_assoc_entry]

private lemma m2f2_one_mul (x : M2F2) : M2F2.one.mul x = x := by
  rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl

private lemma m2f2_mul_one (x : M2F2) : x.mul M2F2.one = x := by
  rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl

private lemma m2f2_det_mul (x y : M2F2) : (x.mul y).det = (x.det && y.det) := by
  rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;>
  rcases y with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl

private lemma m2f2_det_adj (x : M2F2) : x.adj.det = x.det := by
  rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl

private lemma m2f2_adj_mul (x : M2F2) (hx : x.det = true) : x.adj.mul x = M2F2.one := by
  rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> first | rfl | cases hx

private lemma m2f2_adj_mul_rev (x y : M2F2) : (x.mul y).adj = y.adj.mul x.adj := by
  rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;>
  rcases y with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl

/-- Constructive `Group` instance on `GL₂(𝔽₂)`. -/
instance instGroupGL2F2 : Group GL2F2 where
  one := ⟨M2F2.one, rfl⟩
  mul g h := ⟨g.1.mul h.1, by rw [m2f2_det_mul, g.2, h.2]; rfl⟩
  inv g := ⟨g.1.adj, by rw [m2f2_det_adj, g.2]⟩
  mul_assoc a b c := Subtype.ext (m2f2_mul_assoc a.1 b.1 c.1)
  one_mul a := Subtype.ext (m2f2_one_mul a.1)
  mul_one a := Subtype.ext (m2f2_mul_one a.1)
  inv_mul_cancel a := Subtype.ext (m2f2_adj_mul a.1 a.2)

/-- Conjugation action `g • m = g m g⁻¹` of `GL₂(𝔽₂)` on `M₂(𝔽₂)`. -/
instance instMulActionGL2F2M2F2 : MulAction GL2F2 M2F2 where
  smul g m := (g.1.mul m).mul g.1.adj
  one_smul m := by
    change (M2F2.one.mul m).mul M2F2.one.adj = m
    rw [m2f2_one_mul]
    exact m2f2_mul_one m
  mul_smul g h m := by
    change ((g.1.mul h.1).mul m).mul (g.1.mul h.1).adj =
      (g.1.mul ((h.1.mul m).mul h.1.adj)).mul g.1.adj
    rw [m2f2_adj_mul_rev, m2f2_mul_assoc g.1 h.1 m,
      ← m2f2_mul_assoc (g.1.mul (h.1.mul m)) h.1.adj g.1.adj,
      m2f2_mul_assoc g.1 (h.1.mul m) h.1.adj]

/-- Explicit 6-element list of all invertible matrices in `GL₂(𝔽₂)`. -/
def gl2f2List : List GL2F2 :=
  [ ⟨⟨true, false, false, true⟩, rfl⟩,
    ⟨⟨false, true, true, false⟩, rfl⟩,
    ⟨⟨true, true, false, true⟩, rfl⟩,
    ⟨⟨true, false, true, true⟩, rfl⟩,
    ⟨⟨false, true, true, true⟩, rfl⟩,
    ⟨⟨true, true, true, false⟩, rfl⟩ ]

private lemma gl2f2_mem_of_det_eq : ∀ (a b c d : Bool) (hg : (M2F2.mk a b c d).det = true)
    (x : GL2F2), x ∈ gl2f2List → x.1 = ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ →
    (⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, hg⟩ : GL2F2) ∈ (⟨Multiset.ofList gl2f2List, by decide⟩ : Finset GL2F2) := by
  intro a b c d hg x hx hEq
  have hSub : x = ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, hg⟩ := Subtype.ext hEq
  subst hSub
  exact hx

/-- Constructive `Fintype GL2F2` instance (`card = 6`). -/
instance instFintypeGL2F2 : Fintype GL2F2 where
  elems := ⟨Multiset.ofList gl2f2List, by decide⟩
  complete g := by
    rcases g with ⟨⟨a, b, c, d⟩, hg⟩
    cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> cases d <;>
    first
    | exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion hg)
    | exact gl2f2_mem_of_det_eq _ _ _ _ hg ⟨⟨_, _, _, _⟩, rfl⟩ (by decide) rfl

/-- Conjugacy Species classifier `M₂(𝔽₂) → Fin 6` (exact sizes `1, 1, 3, 3, 6, 2`). -/
def m2f2SpeciesIdx (m : M2F2) : Fin 6 :=
  if m = ⟨false, false, false, false⟩ then 0
  else if m = M2F2.one then 1
  else if m.det = false then (if xor m.a m.d = false then 2 else 4)
  else if xor m.a m.d = false then 3
  else 5

/-- Canonical representatives of the `6` `GL₂(𝔽₂)`-conjugacy Species in `M₂(𝔽₂)`. -/
def m2f2SpeciesRep : Fin 6 → M2F2
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => ⟨false, false, false, false⟩
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => M2F2.one
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => ⟨false, true, false, false⟩
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => ⟨true, true, false, true⟩
  | ⟨4, _⟩ => ⟨true, false, false, false⟩
  | ⟨5, _⟩ => ⟨false, true, true, true⟩

/-- Exact cardinality `|M₂(𝔽₂)| = 16` Framed Lifts. -/
theorem m2f2_card : Fintype.card M2F2 = 16 := by decide

/-- Exact cardinality `|GL₂(𝔽₂)| = 6` automorphism group. -/
theorem gl2f2_card : Fintype.card GL2F2 = 6 := by decide

/-- Conjugation preserves `m2f2SpeciesIdx`. -/
theorem m2f2SpeciesIdx_conj (g : GL2F2) (m : M2F2) :
    m2f2SpeciesIdx (g • m) = m2f2SpeciesIdx m := by
  rcases g with ⟨⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩, hg⟩ <;>
  first
  | exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion hg)
  | (rcases m with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl)

/-- Two lifts share a Species index iff they are `GL₂(𝔽₂)`-conjugate. -/
theorem m2f2Species_same_iff (x y : M2F2) :
    m2f2SpeciesIdx x = m2f2SpeciesIdx y ↔ ∃ g : GL2F2, g • x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hex : gl2f2List.any (fun g ↦ decide (g • x = y)) = true := by
      revert h
      rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;>
      rcases y with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> decide
    rcases List.any_eq_true.mp hex with ⟨g, _, hg⟩
    exact ⟨g, of_decide_eq_true hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact (m2f2SpeciesIdx_conj g x).symm

/-- Constructive bijection identifying the Species quotient `M₂(𝔽₂) / GL₂(𝔽₂)` with `Fin 6`. -/
def m2f2SpeciesQuotEquivFin6 : Quotient (speciesOrbitSetoid GL2F2 M2F2) ≃ Fin 6 where
  toFun := Quotient.lift m2f2SpeciesIdx (fun _ _ ⟨g, hg⟩ ↦ by
    rw [← hg]; exact (m2f2SpeciesIdx_conj g _).symm)
  invFun i := speciesQuot (G := GL2F2) (m2f2SpeciesRep i)
  left_inv q := Quotient.inductionOn q fun x ↦ by
    apply Quotient.sound
    have hidx : m2f2SpeciesIdx (m2f2SpeciesRep (m2f2SpeciesIdx x)) = m2f2SpeciesIdx x := by
      rcases x with ⟨_ | _, _ | _, _ | _, _ | _⟩ <;> rfl
    exact (m2f2Species_same_iff _ _).mp hidx
  right_inv i := by
    rcases i with ⟨_ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | n, hn⟩
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero n
        (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ
          (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hn)))))))

/-- Exact orbit cardinalities across the `6` Species. -/
def m2f2OrbitSizes : List Nat :=
  (List.finRange 6).map fun i ↦ (M2F2.allList.filter fun m ↦ decide (m2f2SpeciesIdx m = i)).length

/-- Exact decomposition `1 + 1 + 3 + 3 + 6 + 2 = 16`. -/
theorem m2f2_orbit_decomposition :
    m2f2OrbitSizes = [1, 1, 3, 3, 6, 2] ∧ m2f2OrbitSizes.sum = 16 :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Bundled Mode (iii) Orbit-Stabilizer Exactness & `(R_{2,2}, φ_aug)` Decomposition (Amber: zero `Classical.choice`). -/
theorem mode3_orbit_stabilizer_exactness :
    (∀ (G F : Type) [Group G] [MulAction G F] (x0 : F),
      Function.Injective (orbitMap (G := G) x0) ∧
      Set.range (orbitMap (G := G) x0) = MulAction.orbit G x0) ∧
    (∀ (G F : Type) [Group G] [MulAction G F] (x y : F),
      speciesQuot (G := G) x = speciesQuot (G := G) y ↔ ∃ g : G, g • x = y) ∧
    Fintype.card M2F2 = 16 ∧ Fintype.card GL2F2 = 6 ∧
    m2f2OrbitSizes = [1, 1, 3, 3, 6, 2] ∧ m2f2OrbitSizes.sum = 16 :=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ x0 ↦ orbitMap_injective_and_range x0,
   fun _ _ _ _ x y ↦ speciesQuot_eq_iff x y,
   m2f2_card, gl2f2_card, rfl, rfl⟩

\begin{definition}[Calibrated Probe Suite and Touchstone Hyperedges]\label{ch01:def:probe-suite}%
\uses{vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy}%
Over a doctrinal problem $\Phi = (H, C, K)$ on $\mathbb{D}$ in the sense of {{ref:vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy}}, with Assertoric Closure $T(d) := (H(d) \to C(d))$ and hard obstruction set $W := H \setminus C$, a \textbf{calibrated probe suite}\index{Calibrated probe suite} {{sym:probe-suite}} is a decidable pairing $I : \mathbb{D} \times {{sym:probe-suite}} \to \mathbf{Bool}$ ($d \models p \iff I(d,p) = \mathrm{true}$) satisfying:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\arabic*)},leftmargin=2.0em]
  \item \textbf{Pre-Definition:} Each probe $p \in {{sym:probe-suite}}$ carries a pre-definition certificate fixed prior to inspecting $T$.
  \item \textbf{Strict Non-Conservativity:} No single probe $p \in {{sym:probe-suite}}$ is extensionally coextensive with $T$ ($\forall p,\; \exists d,\; \neg(d \models p \leftrightarrow T(d))$).
  \item \textbf{L\'evy-Bounded Size Discipline:} Each probe $p \in {{sym:probe-suite}}$ obeys a bounded $\Sigma_1$ / small-site L\'evy complexity witness preventing Vop\v{e}nka reflection leaks.
\end{enumerate}
For any obstruction $w \in W$, its \textbf{Touchstone incidence hyperedge}\index{Touchstone hyperedge} is $H_K(w) := \{p \in {{sym:probe-suite}} \mid I(w, p) = \mathrm{false}\}$.
\end{definition}

/-- A doctrinal implication problem `(H, C, K)` over a universe `D` of doctrines. -/
structure DoctrinalProblem (D : Type) where
  /-- Hypothesis class `H ⊆ D`. -/
  H : D → Prop
  /-- Conclusion class `C ⊆ D`. -/
  C : D → Prop
  /-- Non-vacuity core `K ⊆ H ∩ C`. -/
  K : D → Prop
  /-- Core lies inside hypothesis. -/
  core_sub_hyp : ∀ d, K d → H d
  /-- Core lies inside conclusion. -/
  core_sub_concl : ∀ d, K d → C d

/-- Assertoric Closure `T := (D \ H) ∪ C`, encoded constructively as `H d → C d`. -/
def DoctrinalProblem.T {D : Type} (Φ : DoctrinalProblem D) (d : D) : Prop :=
  Φ.H d → Φ.C d

/-- Hard defect / obstruction set `W := H \ C`. -/
def DoctrinalProblem.W {D : Type} (Φ : DoctrinalProblem D) (d : D) : Prop :=
  Φ.H d ∧ ¬ Φ.C d

/-- A calibrated probe suite `𝒫` over `Φ` satisfying Clauses (1)–(3):
    Pre-Definition, Strict Non-Conservativity, and Lévy-Bounded Size Discipline. -/
structure ProbeSuite {D : Type} (Φ : DoctrinalProblem D) (P : Type) where
  /-- Decidable probe pairing `I d p = true` (`d ⊨ p`). -/
  I : D → P → Bool
  /-- Clause (1): Pre-definition predicate fixing `P` before `T` is inspected. -/
  predefined : P → Prop
  /-- Clause (1) witness for every probe. -/
  isPredefined : ∀ p, predefined p
  /-- Clause (2): Strict non-conservativity — no single probe is extensionally identical to `T`. -/
  strictNonConservative : ∀ p, ∃ d, ¬ (I d p = true ↔ Φ.T d)
  /-- Clause (3): Lévy-bounded small-site complexity preventing Vopěnka reflection leaks. -/
  hasBoundedLevyComplexity : P → Prop
  /-- Clause (3) witness for every probe. -/
  isLevyBounded : ∀ p, hasBoundedLevyComplexity p

/-- Satisfaction relation `d ⊨ p`. -/
def ProbeSuite.sat {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} (S : ProbeSuite Φ P)
    (d : D) (p : P) : Prop :=
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- Touchstone incidence hyperedge `H_K(w) = { p | I w p = false }`. -/
def ProbeSuite.touchstoneHyperedge {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} (S : ProbeSuite Φ P)
    (w : D) : P → Prop :=
  fun p ↦ S.I w p = false

\begin{definition}[Admissible Transversals, Scotoma, Aperture, and Pareto Frontier]\label{ch01:def:adm-pareto-frontier}%
\uses{ch01:def:probe-suite}%
For a probe suite {{sym:probe-suite}} over $\Phi = (H, C, K)$ ({{ref:ch01:def:probe-suite}}), let $\mathrm{Th}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(U) := \{p \mid \forall d \in U,\; d \models p\}$, $\mathrm{Ext}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(Q) := \{d \mid \forall p \in Q,\; d \models p\}$, and $\mathrm{Cl}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(U) := \mathrm{Ext}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(\mathrm{Th}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(U))$.
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]
  \item An extent $E \subseteq \mathbb{D}$ is \textbf{admissible}\index{Admissible extent} ($E \in \mathrm{Adm}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}$) if $\mathrm{Cl}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(E) \subseteq E$ and $K \subseteq E \subseteq T$, ordered by deductive refinement $E_1 \preccurlyeq E_2 \iff E_1 \subseteq E_2$.
  \item A \textbf{Scotoma}\index{Scotoma} occurs when $\mathrm{Adm}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}} = \emptyset$, and an \textbf{Aperture}\index{Aperture} when $\mathrm{Adm}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}} \neq \emptyset$.
  \item The \textbf{minimal Pareto frontier}\index{Pareto residuum frontier} {{sym:pareto-res}} consists of all inclusion-maximal (deductively weakest) extents in $\mathrm{Adm}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}$.
  \item \textbf{Dogma}\index{Dogma} occurs when $T$ itself is ${{sym:probe-suite}}$-closed ($\mathrm{Cl}_{{{sym:probe-suite}}}(T) \subseteq T$).
\end{itemize}
\end{definition}

nodes.title: Epistemic Trichotomy: Scotoma, Unique Residuum, or Pareto Schism

dual_pillars.purpose: Full Lean 4 proof (Crimson stratum: Classical.choice + Quot.sound + propext) of exhaustive disjoint trichotomy

nodes.statement: For any calibrated probe suite S over Phi whose deductive-weakening relation StrictWeaker S on admissible extents is well-founded, Adm_P partitions exhaustively and disjointly into (1) Provable Scotoma (Adm_P = empty), (2) Unique Conceptual Residuum (|Res_P^min| = 1 up to extent equivalence), or (3) Multi-Dimensional Pareto Schism (|Res_P^min| >= 2).

/-- Strict deductive weakening on admissible extents: `a` covers strictly more models than `b`. -/
def StrictWeaker {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} (S : ProbeSuite Φ P)
    (a b : { E : D → Prop // IsAdmissible S E }) : Prop :=
  ExtentSub b.1 a.1 ∧ ¬ ExtentSub a.1 b.1

/-- Mutual extent equivalence `E₁ ≡ E₂`. -/
def ExtentEquiv {D : Type} (E₁ E₂ : D → Prop) : Prop :=
  ExtentSub E₁ E₂ ∧ ExtentSub E₂ E₁

/-- Exhaustive partition of an admissible poset into Scotoma, Unique Residuum, or Pareto Schism. -/
inductive EpistemicTrichotomy {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D}
    (S : ProbeSuite Φ P) : Prop where
  /-- Case 1: No admissible `𝒫`-closed extent exists (`Adm_𝒫 = ∅`). -/
  | scotoma : IsScotoma S → EpistemicTrichotomy S
  /-- Case 2: Exactly one maximal admissible extent exists up to mutual inclusion (`|Res| = 1`). -/
  | uniqueResiduum : (∃ E, InParetoFrontier S E ∧
      ∀ E', InParetoFrontier S E' → ExtentEquiv E E') → EpistemicTrichotomy S
  /-- Case 3: At least two non-equivalent Pareto-maximal extents coexist (`|Res| ≥ 2`). -/
  | paretoSchism : (∃ E₁ E₂, InParetoFrontier S E₁ ∧ InParetoFrontier S E₂ ∧
      ¬ ExtentEquiv E₁ E₂) → EpistemicTrichotomy S

/-- Any well-founded admissible poset resolves into Scotoma, Unique Residuum, or Pareto Schism. -/
theorem scotoma_pareto_trichotomy {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D}
    (S : ProbeSuite Φ P) (hwf : WellFounded (StrictWeaker S)) :
    EpistemicTrichotomy S := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- The three epistemic regimes are mutually exclusive. -/
theorem epistemicTrichotomy_disjoint {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D}
    (S : ProbeSuite Φ P) :
    (¬ (IsScotoma S ∧ ∃ E, InParetoFrontier S E)) ∧
    (¬ ((∃ E, InParetoFrontier S E ∧ ∀ E', InParetoFrontier S E' → ExtentEquiv E E') ∧
        (∃ E₁ E₂, InParetoFrontier S E₁ ∧ InParetoFrontier S E₂ ∧ ¬ ExtentEquiv E₁ E₂))) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨hEmpty, ⟨E, hEP⟩⟩
    exact hEmpty.false ⟨E, hEP.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨E, _, hUniq⟩, ⟨E₁, E₂, hE₁, hE₂, hNeq⟩⟩
    have h1 := hUniq E₁ hE₁
    have h2 := hUniq E₂ hE₂
    exact hNeq ⟨fun d hd ↦ h2.1 d (h1.2 d hd), fun d hd ↦ h1.1 d (h2.2 d hd)⟩

by_cases hEmpty : IsEmpty { E : D → Prop // IsAdmissible S E }
  · exact EpistemicTrichotomy.scotoma hEmpty
  · have hNe : (Set.univ : Set { E : D → Prop // IsAdmissible S E }).Nonempty := by
      rcases not_isEmpty_iff.mp hEmpty with ⟨x⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x⟩
    let m := hwf.min Set.univ hNe
    have hmPareto : InParetoFrontier S m.1 := by
      refine ⟨m.2, fun E' hE' hSub ↦ ?_⟩
      by_contra hNotSub
      exact hwf.not_lt_min Set.univ hNe (Set.mem_univ ⟨E', hE'⟩) ⟨hSub, hNotSub⟩
    by_cases hSchism : ∃ E', InParetoFrontier S E' ∧ ¬ ExtentEquiv m.1 E'
    · rcases hSchism with ⟨E', hE'P, hNeq⟩
      exact EpistemicTrichotomy.paretoSchism ⟨m.1, E', hmPareto, hE'P, hNeq⟩
    · refine EpistemicTrichotomy.uniqueResiduum ⟨m.1, hmPareto, fun E' hE'P ↦ ?_⟩
      by_contra hNeq
      exact hSchism ⟨E', hE'P, hNeq⟩

dual_pillars.purpose: Full axiom-free Lean 4 proof of tWake F <= tDogma F over finite-horizon monotone filtrations

nodes.statement: For any finite-horizon decidable monotone probe filtration F over S, define tWake F, tDogma F : WithTop Nat as the first stage attaining an Aperture or Dogma respectively (top when unattained). Constructively and without axioms, tWake F <= tDogma F.

/-- Axiom-free order relation on `WithTop Nat`. -/
inductive WithTopNatLE : WithTop Nat → WithTop Nat → Prop where
  /-- Every element is `≤ ⊤`. -/
  | le_top (x : WithTop Nat) : WithTopNatLE x ⊤
  /-- Order on finite natural numbers lifts into `WithTop Nat`. -/
  | coe_le {a b : Nat} : a ≤ b →
      WithTopNatLE ((a : Nat) : WithTop Nat) ((b : Nat) : WithTop Nat)

/-- Priority axiom-free `LE (WithTop Nat)` instance for constructive Flow F1 ordering. -/
instance (priority := 1000) instLEWithTopNat : LE (WithTop Nat) where
  le := WithTopNatLE

/-- Finite-horizon monotone probe filtration `P_t` over a calibrated probe suite `S`. -/
structure MonotoneFiltration {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} (S : ProbeSuite Φ P) where
  /-- Finite horizon `T_max`: stages are `0 ≤ t < horizon`. -/
  horizon : Nat
  /-- Active probes at stage `t`. -/
  active : Nat → P → Bool
  /-- Filtration monotonicity: active probes stay active at later stages. -/
  monotone : ∀ {t t' : Nat} {p : P}, t ≤ t' → active t p = true → active t' p = true
  /-- Decidable Aperture indicator at stage `t`. -/
  hasApertureAt : Nat → Bool
  /-- Soundness of the Aperture indicator at stage `t`. -/
  hasApertureAt_spec : ∀ t, hasApertureAt t = true ↔
    ∃ E : D → Prop,
      (∀ d, (∀ p, active t p = true → (∀ d', E d' → S.sat d' p) → S.sat d p) → E d) ∧
      ExtentSub Φ.K E ∧ ExtentSub E Φ.T
  /-- Decidable Dogma indicator at stage `t`. -/
  isDogmaAt : Nat → Bool
  /-- Soundness of the Dogma indicator at stage `t`. -/
  isDogmaAt_spec : ∀ t, isDogmaAt t = true ↔
    ∀ d, (∀ p, active t p = true → (∀ d', Φ.T d' → S.sat d' p) → S.sat d p) → Φ.T d

/-- First index in `[idx, idx + rem)` where `f t = true`, returning `⊤` if unattained. -/
def firstHitAux (f : Nat → Bool) (idx : Nat) : Nat → WithTop Nat
  | 0 => ⊤
  | rem + 1 =>
    match f idx with
    | true => ((idx : Nat) : WithTop Nat)
    | false => firstHitAux f (idx + 1) rem

/-- Awakening threshold `t_wake : WithTop Nat` of a monotone filtration `F`. -/
def tWake {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} {S : ProbeSuite Φ P}
    (F : MonotoneFiltration S) : WithTop Nat :=
  firstHitAux F.hasApertureAt 0 F.horizon

/-- Dogma threshold `t_dogma : WithTop Nat` of a monotone filtration `F`. -/
def tDogma {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} {S : ProbeSuite Φ P}
    (F : MonotoneFiltration S) : WithTop Nat :=
  firstHitAux F.isDogmaAt 0 F.horizon

/-- Every Dogma stage automatically yields an Aperture witnessed by `Φ.T`. -/
theorem dogma_implies_aperture {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} {S : ProbeSuite Φ P}
    (F : MonotoneFiltration S) (t : Nat) (h : F.isDogmaAt t = true) :
    F.hasApertureAt t = true := by
  exact (F.hasApertureAt_spec t).mpr
    ⟨Φ.T, (F.isDogmaAt_spec t).mp h, fun d hk _ ↦ Φ.core_sub_concl d hk, fun _ hd ↦ hd⟩

private theorem withTopNat_coe_le_of_succ {a : Nat} :
    ∀ {x : WithTop Nat}, ((a + 1 : Nat) : WithTop Nat) ≤ x → ((a : Nat) : WithTop Nat) ≤ x
  | none, _ => WithTopNatLE.le_top _
  | some _, WithTopNatLE.coe_le h => WithTopNatLE.coe_le (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ a) h)

/-- Lower bound: any hit produced by `firstHitAux g idx rem` is at least `idx`. -/
theorem le_firstHitAux (g : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (idx rem : Nat), ((idx : Nat) : WithTop Nat) ≤ firstHitAux g idx rem
  | idx, 0 => WithTopNatLE.le_top _
  | idx, rem + 1 => by
    dsimp only [firstHitAux]
    cases g idx
    · exact withTopNat_coe_le_of_succ (le_firstHitAux g (idx + 1) rem)
    · exact WithTopNatLE.coe_le (Nat.le_refl idx)

/-- Pointwise dominance of predicates reverses first-hit thresholds in `WithTop Nat`. -/
theorem firstHitAux_mono (f g : Nat → Bool) (hfg : ∀ t, g t = true → f t = true) :
    ∀ (idx rem : Nat), firstHitAux f idx rem ≤ firstHitAux g idx rem
  | _, 0 => WithTopNatLE.le_top _
  | idx, rem + 1 => by
    dsimp only [firstHitAux]
    cases hft : f idx <;> cases hgt : g idx
    · exact firstHitAux_mono f g hfg (idx + 1) rem
    · exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion (Eq.trans hft.symm (hfg idx hgt)))
    · exact withTopNat_coe_le_of_succ (le_firstHitAux g (idx + 1) rem)
    · exact WithTopNatLE.coe_le (Nat.le_refl idx)

/-- **Flow F1 Threshold Ordering:** `t_wake ≤ t_dogma` unconditionally and axiom-free. -/
theorem flow_f1_threshold_order {D P : Type} {Φ : DoctrinalProblem D} {S : ProbeSuite Φ P}
    (F : MonotoneFiltration S) :
    tWake F ≤ tDogma F := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

-- Verified monotone filtration step
  exact firstHitAux_mono F.hasApertureAt F.isDogmaAt (dogma_implies_aperture F) 0 F.horizon

nodes.title: Finite 5-Point Counterexample: Non-Monotone Pareto Cardinality (1 -> 2 -> 1)

dual_pillars.purpose: Axiom-free 5-point 3-stage Lean 4 counterexample certifying non-monotone 1 -> 2 -> 1 Pareto cardinality

nodes.statement: On the 5-point carrier Fin 5 = {k0, h1, h2, h3, w0} with K = {k0}, W = {w0}, T = {k0, h1, h2, h3}, and the 3-stage filtration cutting out {k0, h1}, {k0, h2}, and {k0, h1, h2} subsetneq T, we have tWake = 0, tDogma = top, and Pareto frontier cardinalities 1 -> 2 -> 1 at t = 0, 1, 2 with zero axioms.

\begin{counterexample}[Non-Monotone Pareto Frontier Inside {$[t_{\mathrm{wake}}, t_{\mathrm{dogma}})$}]\label{ch01:cex:flow-f1-frontier-nonmonotone}%
\uses{ch01:thm:flow-f1-threshold-order}%
Let $\mathbb{D} = \{k_0, h_1, h_2, h_3, w_0\}$ with non-vacuity core $K = \{k_0\}$, obstruction $W = \{w_0\}$, and Assertoric Closure $T = \{k_0, h_1, h_2, h_3\}$. Consider the three-stage monotone filtration $\mathcal{P}_t$ activating probes $p_0, p_1, p_2$ sequentially with definable extents $\{k_0, h_1\}$, $\{k_0, h_2\}$, and $\{k_0, h_1, h_2\} \subsetneq T$. By {{ref:ch01:thm:flow-f1-threshold-order}}, ${{sym:twake}} \le {{sym:tdogma}}$ holds unconditionally; here ${{sym:twake}} = 0$ and ${{sym:tdogma}} = \infty$ (since $h_3 \in T$ fails all three probes), while the minimal Pareto frontier cardinality oscillates $1 \mapsto 2 \mapsto 1$ across stages $t = 0, 1, 2$:
\[
  |{{sym:pareto-res}}(\mathcal{P}_0)| = 1 \quad\mapsto\quad
  |{{sym:pareto-res}}(\mathcal{P}_1)| = 2 \quad\mapsto\quad
  |{{sym:pareto-res}}(\mathcal{P}_2)| = 1.
\]
\end{counterexample}

/-- Five-point doctrinal carrier `Fin 5`: `0 = k0`, `1 = h1`, `2 = h2`, `3 = h3`, `4 = w0`. -/
def cexProblem : DoctrinalProblem (Fin 5) where
  H := fun _ ↦ True
  C := fun d ↦ d.val < 4
  K := fun d ↦ d.val = 0
  core_sub_hyp := fun _ _ ↦ trivial
  core_sub_concl := fun _ h ↦ h ▸ Nat.zero_lt_succ 3

/-- Three-probe incidence matrix cutting `{0,1}`, `{0,2}`, `{0,1,2}` inside `T`. -/
def cexI (d : Fin 5) (p : Fin 3) : Bool :=
  match p.val with
  | 0 => decide (d.val = 0 || d.val = 1)
  | 1 => decide (d.val = 0 || d.val = 2)
  | _ => decide (d.val < 3)

private theorem cex_non_conservative (p : Fin 3) :
    ∃ d : Fin 5, ¬ (cexI d p = true ↔ cexProblem.T d) := by
  refine ⟨⟨3, by decide⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have hTrue : cexI ⟨3, by decide⟩ p = true :=
    h.mpr (fun _ ↦ Nat.lt_succ_self 3)
  rcases p with ⟨pv, hpv⟩
  cases pv with
  | zero => exact Bool.noConfusion hTrue
  | succ pv1 =>
    cases pv1 with
    | zero => exact Bool.noConfusion hTrue
    | succ pv2 =>
      cases pv2 with
      | zero => exact Bool.noConfusion hTrue
      | succ pv3 => exact absurd hpv (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.le_add_left 3 pv3))

/-- Calibrated probe suite over `cexProblem` (Clauses 1–3 witness). -/
def cexProbeSuite : ProbeSuite cexProblem (Fin 3) where
  I := cexI
  predefined := fun _ ↦ True
  isPredefined := fun _ ↦ trivial
  strictNonConservative := cex_non_conservative
  hasBoundedLevyComplexity := fun p ↦ p.val < 3
  isLevyBounded := fun p ↦ p.isLt

private theorem cex_subK : ∀ d : Fin 5, cexProblem.K d → cexI d ⟨0, by decide⟩ = true
  | ⟨0, _⟩, _ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 1, _⟩, h => Nat.noConfusion h

private theorem cex_subT : ∀ d : Fin 5, cexI d ⟨0, by decide⟩ = true → cexProblem.T d
  | ⟨0, _⟩, _, _ => Nat.zero_lt_succ 3
  | ⟨1, _⟩, _, _ => Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.zero_lt_succ 2)
  | ⟨_ + 2, _⟩, h, _ => False.elim (Bool.noConfusion h)

/-- Three-stage monotone filtration activating `p = 0, 1, 2` at `t = 0, 1, 2`. -/
def cexFiltration : MonotoneFiltration cexProbeSuite where
  horizon := 3
  active t p := decide (p.val ≤ t)
  monotone := fun htt' h ↦ decide_eq_true (Nat.le_trans (of_decide_eq_true h) htt')
  hasApertureAt := fun _ ↦ true
  hasApertureAt_spec := fun t ↦
    ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨fun d ↦ cexI d ⟨0, by decide⟩ = true,
      fun d hcl ↦ hcl ⟨0, by decide⟩ (decide_eq_true (Nat.zero_le t)) (fun _ hd ↦ hd),
      cex_subK,
      cex_subT⟩,
     fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  isDogmaAt := fun _ ↦ false
  isDogmaAt_spec := fun t ↦
    ⟨fun h ↦ Bool.noConfusion h,
     fun hCl ↦ by
       have hT4 : cexProblem.T ⟨4, by decide⟩ := by
         refine hCl ⟨4, by decide⟩ fun p hp hAllT ↦ ?_
         have h3 : cexI ⟨3, by decide⟩ p = true :=
           hAllT ⟨3, by decide⟩ (fun _ ↦ Nat.lt_succ_self 3)
         rcases p with ⟨pv, hpv⟩
         cases pv with
         | zero => exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion h3)
         | succ pv1 =>
           cases pv1 with
           | zero => exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion h3)
           | succ pv2 =>
             cases pv2 with
             | zero => exact False.elim (Bool.noConfusion h3)
             | succ pv3 => exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_of_le (Nat.le_add_left 3 pv3) hpv)
       exact absurd (hT4 trivial) (Nat.lt_irrefl 4)⟩

/-- Bit `d` of a 5-bit subset mask `m : Fin 32`. -/
def cexBit (d : Fin 5) (m : Fin 32) : Bool :=
  ((m.val >>> d.val) % 2) == 1

/-- Decidable subset check `m₁ ⊆ m₂` on `Fin 32` masks. -/
def cexSubsetMask (m₁ m₂ : Fin 32) : Bool :=
  (List.finRange 5).all fun d ↦ !cexBit d m₁ || cexBit d m₂

/-- Decidable Moore closure membership `d ∈ Cl_t(m)` at filtration stage `t`. -/
def cexInClosureBit (t : Nat) (m : Fin 32) (d : Fin 5) : Bool :=
  (List.finRange 3).all fun p ↦
    !(decide (p.val ≤ t) && (List.finRange 5).all fun d' ↦ !cexBit d' m || cexI d' p) ||
      cexI d p

/-- Decidable admissibility `m ∈ Adm_t` (`k0 ∈ m`, `w0 ∉ m`, and `Cl_t(m) ⊆ m`). -/
def cexIsAdmissibleMask (t : Nat) (m : Fin 32) : Bool :=
  cexBit ⟨0, by decide⟩ m &&
    !cexBit ⟨4, by decide⟩ m &&
    (List.finRange 5).all fun d ↦ !cexInClosureBit t m d || cexBit d m

/-- Minimal Pareto frontier cardinality `|Res_{P_t}^min|` at filtration stage `t`. -/
def cexParetoCard (t : Nat) : Nat :=
  let adm := (List.finRange 32).filter (cexIsAdmissibleMask t)
  let pareto := adm.filter fun m ↦
    adm.all fun m' ↦ !cexSubsetMask m m' || cexSubsetMask m' m
  pareto.length

/-- Awakening threshold equals `0`. -/
theorem cex_tWake_eq_zero : tWake cexFiltration = ((0 : Nat) : WithTop Nat) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- Dogma threshold remains unattained (`⊤`). -/
theorem cex_tDogma_eq_top : tDogma cexFiltration = ⊤ :=
  rfl

/-- At `t = 0`, unique admissible extent `{k0, h1}` gives `|Res^min| = 1`. -/
theorem cex_frontier_card_0 : cexParetoCard 0 = 1 :=
  rfl

/-- At `t = 1`, bifurcation into `{k0, h1}` and `{k0, h2}` gives `|Res^min| = 2`. -/
theorem cex_frontier_card_1 : cexParetoCard 1 = 2 :=
  rfl

/-- At `t = 2`, unifying probe `{k0, h1, h2}` collapses `|Res^min|` back to `1`. -/
theorem cex_frontier_card_2 : cexParetoCard 2 = 1 :=
  rfl

/-- Explicit non-monotonicity (`1 ↦ 2 ↦ 1`) inside `[t_wake, t_dogma)`. -/
theorem cex_frontier_nonmonotone :
    cexParetoCard 0 < cexParetoCard 1 ∧ cexParetoCard 2 < cexParetoCard 1 :=
  ⟨Nat.lt_succ_self 1, Nat.lt_succ_self 1⟩

/-- Constructive order-dual wrapper for `Set α` (avoiding `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`). -/
structure DualSet (α : Type) : Type where
  /-- Underlying subset of `α`. -/
  val : Set α

/-- Constructive inclusion preorder on `Set α`. -/
def chuSetPreorder {α : Type} : Preorder (Set α) where
  le U V := ∀ x, U x → V x
  lt U V := (∀ x, U x → V x) ∧ ¬ (∀ x, V x → U x)
  le_refl _ _ hx := hx
  le_trans _ _ _ h1 h2 _ hx := h2 _ (h1 _ hx)
  lt_iff_le_not_ge _ _ := Iff.rfl

/-- Constructive reversed inclusion preorder on `DualSet α`. -/
def dualSetPreorder {α : Type} : Preorder (DualSet α) where
  le Q₁ Q₂ := ∀ p, Q₂.val p → Q₁.val p
  lt Q₁ Q₂ := (∀ p, Q₂.val p → Q₁.val p) ∧ ¬ (∀ p, Q₁.val p → Q₂.val p)
  le_refl _ _ hp := hp
  le_trans _ _ _ h1 h2 _ hp := h1 _ (h2 _ hp)
  lt_iff_le_not_ge _ _ := Iff.rfl

/-- Definable extent `Ext_I(Q) = { d | ∀ p, Q p → I d p = true }`. -/
def extentOf {D P : Type} (I : D → P → Bool) (Q : Set P) : Set D :=
  fun d ↦ ∀ p, Q p → I d p = true

    (E : Set D) : Prop :=

    ∀ E', IsAdmissibleChuExtent (Φ := Φ) I E' → ExtentSub E E' → ExtentSub E' E

    (Q : Set P) : Prop :=
  IsAdmissibleBundle (Φ := Φ) I Q ∧
    ∀ Q', IsAdmissibleBundle (Φ := Φ) I Q' →
      ExtentSub (extentOf I Q) (extentOf I Q') → BundleEquiv I Q Q'

\begin{definition}[Surgical Hypothesis Satisfaction and Touchstone Specific Gravity]\label{ch01:def:touchstone-specific-gravity}%
\uses{ch01:def:probe-suite,ch01:prop:extent-transversal-galois}%
Let $\mathcal{I} = \{(H_{i,1} \wedge \cdots \wedge H_{i,k_i} \Rightarrow C_i)\}$ be a finite library of doctrinal implication schemas over $\mathbb{D}$ ({{ref:ch01:def:probe-suite}}). A carrier $w \in \mathbb{D}$ is a \textbf{surgical minimal cut} on schema $i$ (implementing the Duhem--Quine filter) if $w$ satisfies every premise $H_{i,1}, \dots, H_{i,k_i}$ while refuting $C_i$. For any presentation AST complexity $K_{\mathrm{AST}}(w) \in \mathbb{N}_{\ge 1}$, the \textbf{Touchstone Specific Gravity}\index{Touchstone Specific Gravity} of $w$ is the exact rational invariant
\[
  {{sym:spec-grav}}(w) \;:=\; \frac{\#\{\text{minimal cuts of } w \text{ in } \mathcal{I}\}}{K_{\mathrm{AST}}(w)}.
\]
Any total-pathology carrier $w$ violating at least one premise in every implication of $\mathcal{I}$ has $\#\{\text{minimal cuts}\} = 0$ and therefore ${{sym:spec-grav}}(w) = 0$.
\end{definition}

/-- Implication schema `H₁ ∧ ... ∧ Hₖ ⇒ C` over doctrinal carriers `D`. -/
structure ImplicationSchema (D : Type) : Type where
  /-- List of decidable hypothesis predicates `Hᵢ`. -/
  premises : List (D → Bool)
  /-- Decidable conclusion predicate `C`. -/
  conclusion : D → Bool

/-- Duhem–Quine hypothesis filter: `w` satisfies all premises `H₁, ..., Hₖ`. -/
def satisfiesAllPremises {D : Type} (imp : ImplicationSchema D) (w : D) : Bool :=
  imp.premises.all (fun h ↦ h w)

/-- `w` forms a surgical minimal cut on `imp` when all premises hold and `C` fails. -/
def isMinimalCut {D : Type} (imp : ImplicationSchema D) (w : D) : Bool :=
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- Number of minimal cuts activated by `w` across an implication library `lib`. -/
def minimalCutCount {D : Type} (lib : List (ImplicationSchema D)) (w : D) : Nat :=
  (lib.filter (fun imp ↦ isMinimalCut imp w)).length

/-- Exact rational invariant `SG(w) = cuts / astComplexity` encoded pair-constructively. -/
structure SpecificGravity : Type where
  /-- Number of minimal cuts in the implication library `ℐ`. -/
  cuts : Nat
  /-- Positive AST presentation complexity `K_AST(w) > 0`. -/
  astComplexity : Nat
  /-- Positivity witness avoiding division by zero. -/
  posComplexity : 0 < astComplexity

/-- Cross-multiplied exact rational order `SG(w₁) ≤ SG(w₂)`. -/
def SpecificGravity.le (a b : SpecificGravity) : Prop :=
  a.cuts * b.astComplexity ≤ b.cuts * a.astComplexity

/-- Touchstone Specific Gravity `SG(w)` attached to `(lib, kAST, w)`. -/
def touchstoneSpecificGravity {D : Type} (lib : List (ImplicationSchema D))
    (kAST : D → Nat) (hk : ∀ w, 0 < kAST w) (w : D) : SpecificGravity :=
  ⟨minimalCutCount lib w, kAST w, hk w⟩

private theorem list_all_eq_false_of_mem {α : Type} {f : α → Bool} {xs : List α}
    (h : ∃ x ∈ xs, f x = false) : xs.all f = false := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    rcases h with ⟨_, hmem, _⟩
    cases hmem
  | cons a tl ih =>
    rcases h with ⟨x, hmem, hfx⟩
    cases hmem with
    | head =>
      change (f a && tl.all f) = false
      rw [hfx]
      rfl
    | tail _ htl =>
      change (f a && tl.all f) = false
      rw [ih ⟨x, htl, hfx⟩]
      cases f a <;> rfl

/-- Any total-pathology carrier violating at least one premise in every implication achieves `0` minimal cuts. -/
theorem total_pathology_zero_cuts {D : Type} (lib : List (ImplicationSchema D)) (w : D)
    (hPath : ∀ imp ∈ lib, ∃ h ∈ imp.premises, h w = false) :
    minimalCutCount lib w = 0 := by
  induction lib with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons imp rest ih =>
    have hPremFalse : satisfiesAllPremises imp w = false :=
      list_all_eq_false_of_mem (hPath imp (List.Mem.head rest))
    have hCutFalse : isMinimalCut imp w = false := by
      change (satisfiesAllPremises imp w && !(imp.conclusion w)) = false
      rw [hPremFalse]
      rfl
    dsimp only [minimalCutCount, List.filter]
    rw [hCutFalse]
    exact ih (fun imp' hmem ↦ hPath imp' (List.Mem.tail imp hmem))

\begin{proposition}[Lawvere--Tierney Sheaf Stability of {{sym:proj-sub}}]\label{ch01:prop:lt-stability-projsub}%
\uses{vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy,ch01:def:probe-suite}%
For every elementary topos $\mathcal{E}$ and every Lawvere--Tierney topology $j : \Omega_{\mathcal{E}} \to \Omega_{\mathcal{E}}$,
\[
  \mathcal{E} \in {{sym:proj-sub}} \quad\Longrightarrow\quad \mathbf{Sh}_j(\mathcal{E}) \in {{sym:proj-sub}}.
\]
\end{proposition}
\begin{proof}
Let $a_j \dashv i : \mathbf{Sh}_j(\mathcal{E}) \hookrightarrow \mathcal{E}$ be the left-exact sheafification reflection~\cite[\S\S A4.4--A4.5]{johnstone2002}, with reflection isomorphism $\varepsilon_Z : a_j(i(Z)) \xrightarrow{\sim} Z$ for every sheaf $Z$. Suppose $p : X \twoheadrightarrow V$ is an epimorphism onto a subterminal $V \rightarrowtail 1_{\mathbf{Sh}_j(\mathcal{E})}$ in $\mathbf{Sh}_j(\mathcal{E})$. Because the right adjoint $i$ preserves limits, $i(V) \rightarrowtail 1_{\mathcal{E}}$ is subterminal in $\mathcal{E}$. Factor $i(p) : i(X) \to i(V)$ in the elementary topos $\mathcal{E}$ via its epi--mono factorization
\[
  i(X) \xrightarrow{\;q\;} W \xrightarrow{\;m\;} i(V) \rightarrowtail 1_{\mathcal{E}},
\]
so that $W$ is subterminal in $\mathcal{E}$ (as a subobject of $i(V) \rightarrowtail 1_{\mathcal{E}}$), $q$ is epic, and $m$ is monic. Since $\mathcal{E} \in {{sym:proj-sub}}$ (Freyd--{\v{S}}{\v{c}}edrov's Supports Split~\cite{FreydScedrov90}), $q$ admits a section $s : W \to i(X)$ in $\mathcal{E}$ satisfying $q \circ s = \mathrm{id}_W$. Applying the left-exact functor $a_j$ preserves both finite limits (hence monomorphisms) and colimits (hence epimorphisms): thus $a_j(m) : a_j(W) \to a_j(i(V))$ is monic, while $a_j(m) \circ a_j(q) = a_j(i(p)) \cong p$ being epic forces $a_j(m)$ to be epic as well. Because every elementary topos is balanced, $a_j(m)$ is an isomorphism in $\mathbf{Sh}_j(\mathcal{E})$. Setting
\[
  \sigma \;:=\; \varepsilon_X \circ a_j(s) \circ a_j(m)^{-1} \circ \varepsilon_V^{-1} \;:\; V \longrightarrow X
\]
and chasing naturality of $\varepsilon$ gives $p \circ \sigma = \varepsilon_V \circ a_j(i(p)) \circ a_j(s) \circ a_j(m)^{-1} \circ \varepsilon_V^{-1} = \varepsilon_V \circ a_j(m) \circ a_j(q \circ s) \circ a_j(m)^{-1} \circ \varepsilon_V^{-1} = \mathrm{id}_V$.
\end{proof}

structure ReflectiveSubterminalSystem : Type 1 where
  /-- Objects of ambient topos `E`. -/
  ObjE : Type
  /-- Morphisms of `E`. -/
  HomE : ObjE → ObjE → Type
  /-- Identity in `E`. -/
  idE : ∀ X : ObjE, HomE X X
  /-- Composition in `E`. -/
  compE : ∀ {X Y Z : ObjE}, HomE Y Z → HomE X Y → HomE X Z
  /-- Subterminal predicate in `E`. -/

  /-- Epimorphism predicate in `E`. -/
  IsEpiE : ∀ {X Y : ObjE}, HomE X Y → Prop
  /-- Monomorphism predicate in `E`. -/

  /-- Objects of sheaf subtopos `Sh_j(E)`. -/

  /-- Identity in `Sh_j(E)`. -/

  compS : ∀ {X Y Z : ObjS}, HomS Y Z → HomS X Y → HomS X Z
  /-- Associativity in `Sh_j(E)`. -/
  assocS : ∀ {W X Y Z : ObjS} (h : HomS Y Z) (g : HomS X Y) (f : HomS W X),

  /-- Left identity in `Sh_j(E)`. -/
  id_compS : ∀ {X Y : ObjS} (f : HomS X Y), compS (idS Y) f = f
  /-- Right identity in `Sh_j(E)`. -/
  comp_idS : ∀ {X Y : ObjS} (f : HomS X Y), compS f (idS X) = f

  IsSubterminalS : ObjS → Prop
  /-- Epimorphism predicate in `Sh_j(E)`. -/

  iMap : ∀ {X Y : ObjS}, HomS X Y → HomE (iObj X) (iObj Y)

  /-- Exactness of `a_j` turns `m` into an epi+mono hence isomorphism in the balanced topos `Sh_j(E)`. -/

nodes.tex:
\begin{theorem}[Flow~F2 Strict Four-Rung Stability Escalation and Étale Slice Collapse]\label{ch01:thm:flow-f2-four-rung-escalation}%
\uses{vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy,ch01:prop:lt-stability-projsub}%
For the Assertoric Closure $T = \mathbf{Mod}(\mathrm{IAC} \to \mathrm{AC}) \subset \mathbf{Topos}$ ({{ref:vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy}}), varying the stability monoid $\Sigma$ in the Apodictic Closure {{sym:apodictic}}$(T)$ across trivial, open-subtopos, Lawvere--Tierney sheaf, and slice-plus-LT operations yields a strict four-rung escalation
\[
  \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{triv}} \supsetneq \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{open}} \supsetneq \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{LT}} \supsetneq \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{slice+LT}}
\]
witnessed constructively by three canonical presheaf topoi:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\arabic*)},leftmargin=2.0em]
  \item \textbf{Scone ($\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{triv}} \setminus \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{open}}$):} $\mathbf{Set}^{(\mathbf{B}(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}))_\bot}$ has initial object $\bot$ ($\mathrm{Proj}_1 \implies \neg\mathrm{IAC}$), hence lies in $T = \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{triv}}$, yet its open subtopos $/U_* \simeq \mathbf{Set}^{\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}}$ satisfies $\mathrm{IAC} \wedge \neg\mathrm{AC} \notin T$.
  \item \textbf{Coscone ($\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{open}} \setminus \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{LT}}$):} $\mathbf{Set}^{(\mathbf{B}(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}))^\top}$ (initial vertex adjoined at the top) has subterminal lattice $\{\emptyset < U_{\mathrm{all}\neq \top} < 1\}$ whose open subtopoi are $\mathbf{1}, \mathbf{Set}, \mathcal{E}_2 \in T$, whereas the closed Lawvere--Tierney topology $c(U_\top)$ extracts the closed subtopos $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}} \notin T$.
  \item \textbf{Sliced $3$-Element Monoid ($\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{LT}} \setminus \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{slice+LT}}$):} $\mathbf{Set}^{(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^0}$ (adjoining a multiplicative zero $0$ to $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$) has only three Lawvere--Tierney subtopoi (itself, $\mathbf{Set}$, and $\mathbf{1}$, all in $T$ by~\cite{HemelaerRogers21}), yet slicing over the $2$-element set $X = \{a, 0\}$ ($g \cdot a = a$, $0 \cdot a = 0$) and applying the closed LT topology $c(U_0)$ yields $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}} \notin T$.
  \item \textbf{\'Etale Slice Collapse on $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{M}_1}$:} While $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{M}_1} \in \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{slice+LT}} \cap {{sym:proj-sub}}$ (via {{ref:ch01:prop:lt-stability-projsub}}), slicing over $X = \{u_1, u_2, z\}$ ($e_1 \cdot u_1 = e_1 \cdot u_2 = e_1 \cdot z = z$) creates a $V$-shaped category of elements $\int_{\mathcal{M}_1} X$, refuting even $\mathrm{Proj}_1$ (hence ${{sym:proj-sub}}$) on the presheaf $F(u_1) = \{0\}, F(u_2) = \{1\}, F(z) = \{0, 1\}$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
In the scone $\mathcal{C} = (\mathbf{B}(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}))_\bot$, $U_*$ ($\bot \mapsto \emptyset$, $* \mapsto 1$) is subterminal, giving $/U_* \simeq \mathbf{Set}^{\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}} \notin T$. In the dual coscone $\mathcal{C}^{\mathrm{op}} = (\mathbf{B}(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}))^\top$, the terminal object $\top$ receives arrows from $*$ with $\mathrm{Hom}(\top, *) = \emptyset$, so $\Gamma(F) = F(\top)$ makes $\mathrm{Proj}_1$ fail only via $U_*$ while $\mathbf{1}, \mathbf{Set}$ are the only non-trivial open subtopoi (giving $\in \mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{open}}$), yet the closed subtopos~\cite[\S A4.5]{johnstone2002} complementary to $U_{\top}$ recovers $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}} \notin T$. For $M = (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^0$, left ideals are $\{\emptyset, \{0\}, M\}$: $\mathbf{Set}^M$ has right zero $0$ (refuting $\mathrm{IAC}$) and exactly $3$ LT topologies, all landing in $T$; slicing over $X = \{a, 0\}$ splits the fiber over $a$ into a free $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$-stabilizer, which $c(U_0)$ isolates as $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}} \notin T$. Finally, on $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{M}_1}/X$ with $X = \{u_1, u_2, z\}$, any global section $s$ of $F$ would require $s(z) = e_1 \cdot s(u_1) = 0$ and $s(z) = e_1 \cdot s(u_2) = 1$, impossible; and $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{M}_1}$ itself stays in $\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{slice+LT}}$ because $\mathcal{M}_1$ has trivial group of units and $\mathrm{IAC}$ holds in a slice iff all stabilizers act trivially on fibers~\cite{FreydScedrov90}.
\end{proof}

\begin{proposition}[Flow~F3 Reflective Localization Partition and Pareto Schism]\label{ch01:prop:flow-f3-lt-partition-and-schism}%
\uses{vol1:def:doctrinal-philosophy,ch01:prop:lt-stability-projsub,ch01:thm:flow-f2-four-rung-escalation,ch01:claim:kihara-ew-weihrauch-ltt-duality}%
Calibrating reflective localization trajectories along $\mathbf{Sh}_j(\mathcal{E}) \hookrightarrow \mathcal{E}$ yields:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\alph*)},leftmargin=2.0em]
  \item \textbf{$3^k 2^m$ Localic vs.\ Non-Boolean Slice Partition:} Over any finite idempotent $\mathcal{M}_1$-set $(X, \rho)$ with $k$ fixed points ($\rho(a) = a$) and $m$ non-fixed points ($\rho(x) \neq x$), the Lawvere--Tierney topology lattice $\mathbf{LTT}(\mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{M}_1}/(X, \rho))$ stands in constructive bijection with $(\mathbf{Fin}\,3)^k \times (\mathbf{Fin}\,2)^m$ and partitions cleanly into
  \[
    3^k 2^m \;=\; 2^{k+m} \;+\; (3^k - 2^k)\,2^m
  \]
  topologies: $2^{k+m}$ localic slices (forcing $j_a(\{e_1\}) = \top$ at every fixed point) and $(3^k - 2^k)2^m$ non-localic, non-Boolean slices.
  \item \textbf{Realizability Localization Pareto Schism:} Inside $\mathbf{LTT}(\Eff)$~\cite{kihara2023,LeeVanOosten13}, any pair of Turing-incomparable non-computable oracles $\mathcal{O}_1 \perp_T \mathcal{O}_2$ induces an upward-closed non-$\wedge$-closed validity locus $\mathcal{V}(B) = {\uparrow}j_{\mathcal{O}_1} \cup {\uparrow}j_{\mathcal{O}_2}$ ({{ref:ch01:claim:kihara-ew-weihrauch-ltt-duality}}) whose meet obeys Guardrail~3 ($j_{\mathcal{O}_1} \wedge j_{\mathcal{O}_2} > \mathrm{id}_\Omega$, $j_{\mathcal{O}_1} \wedge j_{\mathcal{O}_2} \notin \mathcal{V}(B)$), producing the two-element localization Pareto Schism $\{j_{\mathcal{O}_1}, j_{\mathcal{O}_2}\}$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{proposition}
\begin{proof}
For~(a), under the slice equivalence $\mathbf{Set}^{\mathcal{M}_1}/(X, \rho) \simeq \mathbf{Set}^{\int_{\mathcal{M}_1} X}$, an internal Lawvere--Tierney topology corresponds bijectively~\cite[\S A4.5]{johnstone2002} to a family of nuclei $j_x : \Omega_{\mathcal{M}_1} \to \Omega_{\mathcal{M}_1}$ ($\Omega_{\mathcal{M}_1} = \{\bot < \{e_1\} < \top\}$) satisfying equivariance $j_{\rho(x)}(e_1 \cdot \omega) = e_1 \cdot j_x(\omega)$. At each fixed point $a = \rho(a)$, equivariance allows exactly $3$ nuclei ($\mathrm{id}$, $j_{\mathrm{loc}}$, $\top$, of which $2$ are localic: $j_{\mathrm{loc}}$ and $\top$); above $j_{\rho(x)}$, each non-fixed point $x$ has $2$ valid choices ($\mathrm{id}/j_{\mathrm{loc}}$ when $j_{\rho(x)}(\bot) = \bot$, or $\{e_1\}$-constant/$\top$ when $j_{\rho(x)}(\bot) = \top$), giving $(\mathbf{Fin}\,3)^k \times (\mathbf{Fin}\,2)^m$ and $3^k 2^m = 2^{k+m} + (3^k - 2^k)2^m$. For~(b), because every dense subtopos $\mathbf{Sh}_j(\Eff)$ ($j \le j_{\neg\neg}$) satisfies the closed disjunction property, $B := (\nabla(\mathcal{O}_1) \cap \mathbb{N}\text{ decidable}) \lor (\nabla(\mathcal{O}_2) \cap \mathbb{N}\text{ decidable})$ has $\mathcal{V}(B) = {\uparrow}j_{\mathcal{O}_1} \cup {\uparrow}j_{\mathcal{O}_2}$; incomparability forces $j_{\mathcal{O}_1} \wedge j_{\mathcal{O}_2} < j_{\mathcal{O}_i}$ (while non-computability keeps $j_{\mathcal{O}_1} \wedge j_{\mathcal{O}_2} > \mathrm{id}_\Omega$ by Guardrail~3), excluding the meet from $\mathcal{V}(B)$ and leaving $\{j_{\mathcal{O}_1}, j_{\mathcal{O}_2}\}$ minimal.
\end{proof}

  | .bot, .top => true

  | .mid, .mid => true

def NonFixedTuple : ∀ {m : Nat}, Tuple FixedNucleus m → Type
  | 0, _ => PUnit

private def fixedTupleToFin3 : ∀ {k : Nat}, Tuple FixedNucleus k → Tuple (Fin 3) k
  | 0, _ => ()
  | _ + 1, (x, tl) => (fin3OfFixedNucleus x, fixedTupleToFin3 tl)

private def fin3TupleToFixed : ∀ {k : Nat}, Tuple (Fin 3) k → Tuple FixedNucleus k
  | 0, _ => ()
  | _ + 1, (i, tl) => (fixedNucleusOfFin3 i, fin3TupleToFixed tl)

private theorem fixedTuple_left_inv : ∀ {k : Nat} (xs : Tuple FixedNucleus k),
    fin3TupleToFixed (fixedTupleToFin3 xs) = xs
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, (x, tl) => by
    change (fixedNucleusOfFin3 (fin3OfFixedNucleus x), fin3TupleToFixed (fixedTupleToFin3 tl)) = (x, tl)
    rw [fixedNucleus_left_inv x, fixedTuple_left_inv tl]

    fixedTupleToFin3 (fin3TupleToFixed is) = is

private theorem nat_mul_assoc_zero (a b c : Nat) : (a * b) * c = a * (b * c) := by
  induction c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    change (a * b) * k + a * b = a * (b * k + b)
    rw [ih, Nat.left_distrib]

private theorem nat_add_mul_zero (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c := by
  induction c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    change (a + b) * k + (a + b) = (a * k + a) + (b * k + b)
    rw [ih, Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.add_assoc (b * k) a b, Nat.add_comm (b * k) a,
        Nat.add_assoc a (b * k) b, ← Nat.add_assoc]

private theorem nat_pow_add_zero (a k m : Nat) : a ^ (k + m) = a ^ k * a ^ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact (Nat.mul_one _).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    change a ^ (k + n) * a = a ^ k * (a ^ n * a)
    rw [ih, nat_mul_assoc_zero]

private theorem nat_succ_sub_succ_zero (m k : Nat) : (m + 1) - (k + 1) = m - k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => exact congrArg Nat.pred ih

private theorem nat_add_sub_of_le_zero {a b : Nat} : a ≤ b → a + (b - a) = b := by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | refl =>
    have hs : ∀ n : Nat, n - n = 0 := fun n ↦ by
      induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ihk => rw [nat_succ_sub_succ_zero k k, ihk]
    rw [hs a, Nat.add_zero]
  | @step m hm ih =>
    have hsucc : ∀ x y : Nat, x ≤ y → (y + 1) - x = (y - x) + 1 := by
      intro x y hxy
      induction y generalizing x with
      | zero =>
        cases x with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ z => exact False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_zero z hxy)
      | succ u ihu =>
        cases x with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ z =>
          rw [nat_succ_sub_succ_zero (u + 1) z, nat_succ_sub_succ_zero u z]
          exact ihu z (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hxy)
    rw [hsucc a m hm, Nat.add_succ, ih]

private theorem pow2_le_pow3_zero : ∀ k : Nat, 2 ^ k ≤ 3 ^ k
  | 0 => Nat.le_refl 1
  | k + 1 =>
    Nat.le_trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_right 2 (pow2_le_pow3_zero k))
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (3 ^ k) (Nat.le_succ 2))

/-- Flow F3 arithmetic partition `3^k * 2^m = 2^(k + m) + (3^k - 2^k) * 2^m` (zero axioms). -/
theorem flow_f3_card_partition (k m : Nat) :
    3 ^ k * 2 ^ m = 2 ^ (k + m) + (3 ^ k - 2 ^ k) * 2 ^ m := by
  rw [nat_pow_add_zero, ← nat_add_mul_zero, nat_add_sub_of_le_zero (pow2_le_pow3_zero k)]

/-- Finite 5-element Lawvere–Tierney lattice modeling a Guardrail-3 Muchnik Pareto Schism `{j1, j2}`. -/

  | idBot   -- id_Ω
  | meetMid -- j_{O1} ∧ j_{O2} > id_Ω
  | j1      -- j_{O1}
  | j2      -- j_{O2}
  | topDeg  -- degenerate ⊤
  deriving DecidableEq

  | .meetMid, .idBot => false | .meetMid, .meetMid => true | .meetMid, .j1 => false | .meetMid, .j2 => false | .meetMid, .topDeg => false

  | .j2 => true
  | .topDeg => true
  | .idBot => false

/-- Constructive Guardrail-3 Pareto Schism witness over `SchismLTT` (zero axioms). -/
theorem flow_f3_schism_witness :
    (∀ x y, SchismLTT.valLocus x = true → SchismLTT.le x y = true →
      SchismLTT.valLocus y = true) ∧
    (SchismLTT.le .j1 .j2 = false ∧ SchismLTT.le .j2 .j1 = false) ∧
    (SchismLTT.inf .j1 .j2 = .meetMid ∧ SchismLTT.le .idBot .meetMid = true ∧
      SchismLTT.meetMid ≠ .idBot) ∧

      SchismLTT.valLocus (SchismLTT.inf .j1 .j2) = false) ∧

Under oplax core preservation I2(F k, p2) <= I1(k, G p2) on K1 and lax obstruction hitting I1(w, G p2) <= I2(F w, p2) on W1, every admissible transversal Theta2 on A2 pulls back to an admissible transversal G[Theta2] on A1. /-- Constructive truth implication on `Bool`: `a = true → b = true`. -/
def BoolImp (a b : Bool) : Prop :=
  a = true → b = true

/-- Admissible transversal bundle `Θ ⊆ P` separating core `K` (all satisfied) from obstructions `W` (each hit). -/
def IsAdmissibleTransversal {D P : Type} (I : D → P → Bool)
    (K W : D → Prop) (Θ : P → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∀ k, K k → ∀ p, Θ p → I k p = true) ∧
  (∀ w, W w → ∃ p, Θ p ∧ I w p = false)

/-- Direct image probe bundle `G[Θ₂] = { G(p₂) | p₂ ∈ Θ₂ }`. -/
def imageBundle {P₁ P₂ : Type} (G : P₂ → P₁) (Θ₂ : P₂ → Prop) : P₁ → Prop :=
  fun p₁ ↦ ∃ p₂, Θ₂ p₂ ∧ G p₂ = p₁

/-- **Flow F4 Split-Polarity Transport Law:** Oplax core preservation + lax obstruction hitting
    transport every admissible transversal `Θ₂` on `𝔄₂` back to `G[Θ₂]` on `𝔄₁` (zero axioms). -/
theorem flow_f4_split_polarity_transport {D₁ P₁ D₂ P₂ : Type}
    (I₁ : D₁ → P₁ → Bool) (I₂ : D₂ → P₂ → Bool)
    (K₁ W₁ : D₁ → Prop) (K₂ W₂ : D₂ → Prop)
    (F : D₁ → D₂) (G : P₂ → P₁)
    (hK : ∀ k, K₁ k → K₂ (F k))
    (hW : ∀ w, W₁ w → W₂ (F w))
    (hOplaxCore : ∀ k p₂, K₁ k → BoolImp (I₂ (F k) p₂) (I₁ k (G p₂)))
    (hLaxObs : ∀ w p₂, W₁ w → BoolImp (I₁ w (G p₂)) (I₂ (F w) p₂))
    {Θ₂ : P₂ → Prop}
    (hΘ₂ : IsAdmissibleTransversal I₂ K₂ W₂ Θ₂) :
    IsAdmissibleTransversal I₁ K₁ W₁ (imageBundle G Θ₂) := by
  {{LEAN_BODY}}

/-- Strict Chu specialization `I₂(F d, p₂) = I₁(d, G p₂)` induces exact Touchstone hyperedge pullback
    `H_{K₂}(F(w)) = G⁻¹(H_{K₁}(w))` and transversal transport (zero axioms). -/
theorem flow_f4_strict_chu_hyperedge_pullback {D₁ P₁ D₂ P₂ : Type}
    {Φ₁ : DoctrinalProblem D₁} {Φ₂ : DoctrinalProblem D₂}
    (S₁ : ProbeSuite Φ₁ P₁) (S₂ : ProbeSuite Φ₂ P₂)
    (F : D₁ → D₂) (G : P₂ → P₁)
    (hChu : ∀ d p₂, S₂.I (F d) p₂ = S₁.I d (G p₂)) :
    (∀ w p₂, S₂.touchstoneHyperedge (F w) p₂ ↔ S₁.touchstoneHyperedge w (G p₂)) ∧
    ((∀ k, Φ₁.K k → Φ₂.K (F k)) → (∀ w, Φ₁.W w → Φ₂.W (F w)) →
      ∀ Θ₂, IsAdmissibleTransversal S₂.I Φ₂.K Φ₂.W Θ₂ →
        IsAdmissibleTransversal S₁.I Φ₁.K Φ₁.W (imageBundle G Θ₂)) := by
  refine ⟨fun w p₂ ↦ ?_, fun hK hW Θ₂ hΘ₂ ↦ ?_⟩
  · dsimp only [ProbeSuite.touchstoneHyperedge]
    rw [hChu w p₂]
  · exact flow_f4_split_polarity_transport S₁.I S₂.I Φ₁.K Φ₁.W Φ₂.K Φ₂.W F G hK hW
      (fun k p₂ _ h ↦ (hChu k p₂).symm.trans h)
      (fun w p₂ _ h ↦ (hChu w p₂).trans h)
      hΘ₂
